room.name: The White Mile
room.hint: Carry momentum across every broken perch. Stay low beneath flowers; bounce up the end walls and turn back. One fire, one continuous climb.

bank.csideDescription: One immense, continuous climb. Long momentum gaps, brittle landings, low flower tunnels, wallbounce turns and an aerial undercut. One starting fire.
